prompts.object: Editorial still life photograph of a hand-built tabletop model made of paper, card, matte ceramic and brushed steel, photographed as a physical object on a plain pale surface, soft north-window light with long gentle shadows, 50mm lens, shallow depth of field, matte film grade with lifted whites. Wide tabletop model composed along the horizontal centre line inside the middle three fifths of the frame, with wide empty table on both sides: at the left a loose cluster of rough unfinished white six-sided hexagon tiles, at the centre tiles locking into a regular deep blue honeycomb, and at the right a low tidy stack of thin blue hexagon tiles. Subject spread along the horizontal centre line with wide quiet margins left and right. Color palette: crisp white and pale mist-blue surfaces, deep blue and slate, soft grey. There is exactly one amber object in the frame: one small separate six-sided hexagon tile in amber glass resting on top of the stack at the right. All other objects are white, grey, blue or slate. No text, no logos, no writing.
